instruction: Find the 2022 NFL playoff schedule on the NFL website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from NFL.com to the 2022 playoff schedule page. Uses regex pattern matching to accept any valid 2022 playoff schedule URL, providing flexibility for different URL structures. Similar navigation complexity to original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses URL pattern matching to verify navigation to 2022 NFL playoff schedule
Metric function 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' properly extracts URL from result and checks regex pattern
Regex pattern 'https://www\\.nfl\\.com/schedules/.*2022.*playoff' correctly requires: NFL.com domain, 'schedules' path, '2022' year, and 'playoff' keyword
Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' appropriately extracts the currently active Chrome tab URL
Data flow is correct: getter returns URL string, metric handles both string and dict formats, expected provides regex patterns
Coverage is complete: evaluator verifies all key requirements (NFL website, 2022, playoff, schedule)
Edge cases handled: empty results return 0.0, non-matching URLs return 0.0, pattern is flexible enough for various URL structures
